facts.text: I wrote a fourth email using a prompt about Gary Dranow’s latest album Destiny Road.
Gary Dranow’s love for music remained an integral part of his life.
Gary Dranow poured his heart and soul into creating the album Destiny Road for a decade.
The album Destiny Road is autobiographical and deeply personal.
The album Destiny Road chronicles Gary Dranow’s struggles, triumphs, and everything in between.
The album Destiny Road was initially written in the 1990s.
The band intended to release Destiny Road in the summer of 1998.
Destiny Road was recorded on Jefferson Airplane’s old 2" 16 Track machine.
The 2" 16 Track machine used for recording was owned by Gary Dranow’s producer Jerry Manfredi.
The legend of the 2" 16 Track machine is that they had it on their private airplane.
Gary Dranow finished recording the tracks and then abruptly moved to Park City, Utah.
Gary Dranow never got the chance to master the tracks.
For the next ten years, Gary Dranow concentrated on ski racing and coaching.
In 2008, Gary Dranow got back into music.
By 2021, Gary Dranow re-established The Manic Emotions.
The Manic Emotions band members were located in the Salt Lake City area.
Almost immediately after re-establishing The Manic Emotions, they started playing shows.
Gary Dranow is a consummate performer.
Gary Dranow’s live sets demonstrate energy, charisma, and unwavering passion for music.
Gary Dranow has struggled with manic depression.
Gary Dranow’s struggles with manic depression have fueled his creativity.
Gary Dranow’s struggles with manic depression inspired him to make music that speaks to the human experience.
Gary Dranow’s lyrical inspiration is influenced by having his personal and professional life disrupted by sensitivity to others around him.
The song "Made it Another Day" speaks directly to Gary Dranow’s experience.
Gary Dranow described going to sleep with the weight of the world on his shoulders and waking the next morning free of those feelings.
Gary Dranow described being surprised that he made it another day to take on his daily struggle once again.
Gary Dranow said the lyric "Like a rat in a wheel" brings the image of never-ending struggle to get his personal life in order.
Gary Dranow described being dissuaded at the end of every day.
Gary Dranow described making progress in inevitable headwinds that buffet his life.
Gary Dranow is thrilled to be performing and sharing his music with fans once again.
Gary Dranow and The Manic Emotions are expected to have more performances in 2023 and beyond.
